zh: 移除左上角侧边栏图标上的冗余红点角标，保留侧边栏内的系统告警横幅展示。
重塑底部语音双按钮交互与响应体验：右下角绿色波形按钮升级为「AI 实时语音对话」（支持 1.4 秒静音自动发送、实时打断与原生语音播报），麦克风按钮专注「语音转文字」输入，并扩大触控命中区域、打通权限与报错提示。
重构跨平台共享 Markdown 块级渲染引擎（KMP MarkdownParser）：支持自动拆分粘连标题与编号列表、渲染大号清晰标题与悬挂缩进条目、将本地文件路径与函数链接渲染为简洁的代码语言胶囊徽标（JS / PY 等），全面提升长文排版阅读体验。
en: Remove the stray red badge dot on the top-left sidebar toggle while keeping the alert banner inside the drawer.

Fix & clarify bottom-right voice buttons: assign the microphone button to reliable speech-to-text dictation (with full hit target & permission error surfacing) and turn the green waveform button into a hands-free AI Voice Conversation mode with auto-silence turn detection, interruption, and native TTS playback.

Upgrade mobile chat formatting with a shared KMP block+inline Markdown parser: auto-splits collapsed headings/numbered lists, renders spacious typography with hanging indents, code blocks, tables, and compact symbol/language pills instead of raw file:// URLs.
